# Aliciagiks4art — Graphic & Motion Design Portfolio

> Live portfolio website for Mary Alicia Wangui (Alicia), a remote graphic designer and motion artist building cinematic brand systems, campaign art, motion graphics, and art direction for digital-first brands.

## About Mary Alicia Wangui
Mary Alicia Wangui works at the intersection of brand systems and moving image. She designs cohesive visual identities and dynamic motion graphics that feel cinematic up close and clear at a glance. She operates remotely and is available worldwide for freelance contracts, agency work, and creative collaborations.

## Creative Services & Capabilities
- **Branding & Visual Identity:** Distinct brand systems, logo direction, campaign visuals, and cohesive design languages.
- **Graphic Design:** Key art posters, social graphics, marketing collateral, and polished digital/print creative asset suites.
- **Motion Graphics:** Animated concepts, kinetic typography, title sequences, social motion, and visual campaign storytelling.
- **Illustration:** Original art direction, character concepts, editorial illustration, and expressive digital visuals.

## Portfolio Directory
- [Selected Projects](https://netlify.app): Filtered showcase of professional motion, print, and branding design work.
- [About the Artist](https://netlify.app): Profile, background summary, and freelance operational parameters.
- [Contact & Collaboration](https://netlify.app): Built-in intake portal to start new creative projects.

## Project Timelines & Communication
- **Response Window:** Inquiries receive a professional reply within 24 hours.
- **Direct Reach:** Prospects can contact Mary Alicia Wangui directly via Email or WhatsApp using the communication links in the contact footer.
